address: 27 Minzu Road, Banqiao District, New Taipei, Taiwan
bio: With brick walls and wooden beams, the space exudes a rustic cabin vibe. Friendly servers dressed in Hakkanese floral prints provide thoughtful, detail-oriented service. The chef has over 30 years of experience, and his tonic soups are especially popular. Slow cooked for 8 hours, the Shou Wu Silkie chicken soup is made from 5kg organic birds bred in Yunlin and dozens of Chinese herbs and comes with hand-made noodles to soak up the soup.
